(() => { const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); if(c.dataset.coverCount !== '12') throw Error('Open layout not active'); window.kitOpen = c.toDataURL(); return 'Open: 12 reusable objects'; })()

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); if(c.dataset.coverCount !== '48') throw Error('Dense layout not active'); if(c.toDataURL() === window.kitOpen) throw Error('Artwork did not redraw'); return 'Dense: 48 objects; artwork changed'; })()

(() => { const original = URL.createObjectURL; URL.createObjectURL = function(blob) { blob.text().then(text => window.kitExport = JSON.parse(text)); return original.call(URL,blob); }; return 'Export capture ready'; })()

(() => { const m = window.kitExport; if(m.type !== 'map' || m.layers.find(l => l.name === 'Scenery').objects.length !== 48) throw Error('Wrong export'); return 'Tiled export: dense map, 48 scenery objects'; })()

(async () => { const t = window.__controlsTest; t.setKeys(['KeyW']); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r,500)); const y = t.getYaw(); t.setKeys(['KeyW','KeyA']); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r,700)); t.setKeys([]); if(t.getSpeed() <= 0.1 || t.getYaw() - y <= 0.05 || t.getPosition().x >= 0) throw Error('A must move left'); return 'A turns left while driving'; })()

(async () => { const t = window.__controlsTest; t.setKeys(['KeyW']); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r,500)); const y = t.getYaw(); t.setKeys(['KeyW','KeyD']); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r,700)); t.setKeys([]); if(t.getSpeed() <= 0.1 || t.getYaw() - y >= -0.05 || t.getPosition().x <= 0) throw Error('D must move right'); return 'D turns right while driving'; })()

(async () => { const t = window.__controlsTest, p = JSON.stringify(t.getPosition()); t.setKeys(['KeyW']); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r,300)); t.setKeys([]); if(JSON.stringify(t.getPosition()) !== p) throw Error('Pause failed'); return 'Pause holds position'; })()
